tools.name: cast_hexagram
tools.description: Cast an I Ching (Yijing) hexagram with the classic three-coin method. Returns the primary hexagram (King Wen number, Chinese name, Unicode symbol), its judgment in classical Chinese with a public-domain English translation, a plain-language meaning, any moving (changing) lines, and the transformed h

tools.name: get_hexagram
tools.description: Look up one of the 64 I Ching hexagrams by King Wen number (1-64), Chinese name, pinyin, or Wilhelm English name. Returns trigram composition, judgment (classical Chinese + Legge English translation), all six line texts, a plain-language meaning, and a link to the full page on thehexagrams.com.

tools.name: list_hexagrams
tools.description: List all 64 I Ching hexagrams with King Wen numbers, Chinese names, pinyin, Wilhelm English names, and Unicode symbols.
